mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID : kr.go.iop.ci.sc.cp.cpm.ProdMapper.select.selectInstBasedSubscrProdList - 부처별 구독 상품 목록 조회 */ I.INSTITUTION_CODE /* 기관코드 */ ,I.INSTITUTION_NAME /* 기관명 */ ,B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(B.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_NM /* SAAS제품제공방식구분명 */ ,B.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD /* SAAS제품제공방식구분코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(B.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_NM /* SAAS제품유형명 */ ,B.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD /* SAAS제품유형코드 */ ,B.SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* SAAS제품명 */ ,B.SAAS_PRDCT_SMRY_CN /* SAAS제품요약내용 */ ,B.PRDCT_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 제품이미지첨부파일그룹번호 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_INST_M I LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L A ON I.INSTITUTION_CODE = A.INST_USER_INTG_ID AND A.PRDSBSC_STTS_CD IN ('A0040002', 'A0040004') /* 구독상태(구독 또는 구독취소요청) */ LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M B ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT /* 사용자 소속 기관 조회 */ C.INSTITUTION_CODE /* 기관코드 */ ,C.INSTITUTION_NAME /* 기관명 */ ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL ,NULL FROM USCM.TBCM_INST_M C WHERE C.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.select.selectProdReviewList - 상품 후기 목록 조회 */ SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* saas제품아이디 */ , EVLTR_ID /* 평가자아이디 */ , SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR /* saas제품평가점수 */ , SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_CN /* saas제품평가내용 */ , COALESCE(B.USER_NAME, '') AS USER_NM /* 사용자명 */ , FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ , FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID /* 최초생성처리자아이디 */ , LAST_CHG_DT /* 최종변경일시 */ , LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_L A LEFT OUTER JOIN USCM.TBCM_USER_M_TEMP B ON A.EVLTR_ID = B.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE 1=1
AND SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN EVLTR_ID = #{accountId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , FRST_CRT_DT DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN EVLTR_ID = #{accountId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR DESC, FRST_CRT_DT DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN EVLTR_ID = #{accountId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , FRST_CRT_DT DESC

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.select.selectProdReviewInfo - 상품 리뷰 정보 조회 */ COUNT(*) AS SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_CNT , COALESCE(TRUNC(AVG(SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR)::numeric, 1), 0) AS SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR_AVG FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_L WHERE 1=1
AND SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.update.updateProdReview - 상품 후기 수정 요청 */ USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_L SET SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR= #{saasPrdctEvlScr} /* saas제품평가점수 */ ,SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_CN = #{saasPrdctEvlCn} /* saas제품평가내용 */ ,LAST_CHG_DT = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') /* 최종변경일시 */ WHERE EVLTR_ID = #{evltrId} AND SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* kr.go.iop.ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.select.selectProdInfo - 카탈로그 상품 상세 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD /* SAAS제품제공방식구분코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(A.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_NM /* SAAS제품제공방식구분명 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD /* SAAS제품유형코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(A.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_NM /* SAAS제품유형명 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* SAAS제품명 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_DTL_CN /* SAAS제품상세내용 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_SMRY_CN /* SAAS제품요약내용 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD /* SAAS제품제조사코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(A.SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_NM /* SAAS제품제조사명 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN /* SAAS제품API버전일련번호 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DMN_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스도메인주소 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DTL_URL_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스상세URL주소 */ ,A.SAAS_PRDCT_FAQ_ADDR /* SAAS제품FAQ주소 */ ,A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ ,A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN /* 상품안내문등록여부 */ ,A.PRDCT_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 제품이미지첨부파일그룹번호 */ ,A.SCRN_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 화면이미지첨부파일그룹번호 */ ,A.EXPLN_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 설명이미지첨부파일그룹번호 */ ,A.FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID /* 최초생성처리자아이디 */ ,A.FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ ,A.LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ ,A.LAST_CHG_DT /* 최종변경일시 */ ,(SELECT /* 기관의 구독 상태를 가져온다.*/ PRDSBSC_STTS_CD FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L WHERE SAAS_PRDCT_ID = A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND INST_USER_INTG_ID = #{institutionCode} ORDER BY PRDSBSC_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AS PRDSBSC_STTS_CD FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M A WHERE A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'Y'

SELECT /* SQL_ID : kr.go.iop.ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.select.selectProdServiceList - 제품 서비스 조회 */ B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ ,B.SRVC_ID /* 서비스아이디 */ ,B.SRVC_NM /* 서비스명 */ ,B.SRVC_CN /* 서비스내용 */ ,B.SRVC_SMRY_CN /* 서비스요약내용 */ ,B.SRVC_DTL_URL_ADDR /* 서비스상세URL주소 */ ,B.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ ,B.ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 첨부파일그룹번호 */ ,C.ATCH_FILE_SN /* 첨부파일일련번호 */ ,B.FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ ,B.FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID /* 최초생성처리자아이디 */ ,B.LAST_CHG_DT /* 최종변경일시 */ ,B.LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M A LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_L B ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_ARCH_FILE_L C ON B.ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO = C.ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID : kr.go.iop.ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.select.selectProdServiceInfo - 제품 서비스 상세 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ ,A.SRVC_ID /* 서비스아이디 */ ,A.SRVC_NM /* 서비스명 */ ,A.SRVC_CN /* 서비스내용 */ ,A.SRVC_SMRY_CN /* 서비스요약내용 */ ,A.SRVC_DTL_URL_ADDR /* 서비스상세URL주소 */ ,A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ ,A.ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 첨부파일그룹번호 */ ,A.FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ ,A.FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID /* 최초생성처리자아이디 */ ,A.LAST_CHG_DT /* 최종변경일시 */ ,A.LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_L A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND A.SRVC_ID = #{srvcId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID : kr.go.iop.ci.sc.cp.cpm.mapper.ProdMapper.select.selectProdSubscrInstList - 제품 구독 기관 목록 조회*/ AA.INSTITUTION_NAME AS INSTITUTION_NAME /* 기관명 */ ,AA.INSTITUTION_CODE AS INSTITUTION_CODE /* 기관번호 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L AB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT /* 기관명칭을 반환한다. */ A.INSTITUTION_NAME ,A.INSTITUTION_CODE FROM USCM.TBCM_INST_M A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY A.INSTITUTION_NAME, A.INSTITUTION_CODE ) AA ON AB.INST_USER_INTG_ID = AA.INSTITUTION_CODE JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M AC ON AC.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = AB.SAAS_PRDCT_ID WHERE 1=1 AND AC.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD ='A0010001' /* 상품제공형태코드 : 기관(SAAS) */ AND AB.PRDSBSC_STTS_CD IN ('A0040002','A0040004') /* 구독상태 : 구독중, 구독 취소요청 */ AND AC.USE_YN ='Y' AND AC.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cp.cpm.ProdMapper.select.selectInstSubscrProdList - 기관 구독 상품 목록 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD /* SAAS제품제공방식구분코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_NM /* SAAS제품제공방식구분명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD /* SAAS제품유형코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_NM /* SAAS제품유형명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* SAAS제품명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_DTL_CN /* SAAS제품상세내용 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SMRY_CN /* SAAS제품요약내용 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD /* SAAS제품제조사코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_NM /* SAAS제품제조사명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN /* SAAS제품API버전일련번호 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DMN_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스도메인주소 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DTL_URL_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스상세URL주소 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_FAQ_ADDR /* SAAS제품FAQ주소 */ , A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN /* 상품안내문등록여부 */ , A.PRDCT_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 제품이미지첨부파일그룹번호 */ , A.FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ , B.API_CMNC_SCS_YN /* API통신성공여부 */ , C.ATCH_FILE_SN /* 첨부파일일련번호 */ , COALESCE(D.SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT, 0) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT /* 후기수 */ , COALESCE(TRUNC(D.SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG, 1), 0) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG /* 평균별점 */ , E.PRDSBSC_STTS_CD /* 제품구독상태코드 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M A LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_CMNC_MNG_L B ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND B.SRVR_SE_CD = 'A0060002' /* 운영서버 */ LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_ARCH_FILE_L C ON A.PRDCT_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO = C.ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SAAS_PRDCT_ID , COUNT(1) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT , AVG(SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_L GROUP BY SAAS_PRDCT_ID ) D ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = D.SAAS_PRDCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SAAS_PRDCT_ID , INST_USER_INTG_ID , INST_USER_SE_CD , PRDSBSC_SN , PRDSBSC_STTS_CD FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SAAS_PRDCT_ID, INST_USER_INTG_ID, INST_USER_SE_CD ORDER BY PRDSBSC_SN DESC) AS RN , SAAS_PRDCT_ID , INST_USER_INTG_ID , INST_USER_SE_CD , PRDSBSC_SN , PRDSBSC_STTS_CD FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L ) WHERE RN = 1 ) E ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = E.SAAS_PRDCT_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'Y' AND E.PRDSBSC_STTS_CD IN ('A0040002', 'A0040004') /* 구독중 */ AND E.INST_USER_INTG_ID = #{institutionCode} ORDER BY A.FRST_CRT_DT DESC

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cp.cpm.ProdMapper.select.selectPopularProdList - 인기 상품 목록 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD /* SAAS제품제공방식구분코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_NM /* SAAS제품제공방식구분명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD /* SAAS제품유형코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_NM /* SAAS제품유형명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* SAAS제품명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_DTL_CN /* SAAS제품상세내용 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SMRY_CN /* SAAS제품요약내용 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD /* SAAS제품제조사코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_NM /* SAAS제품제조사명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN /* SAAS제품API버전일련번호 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DMN_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스도메인주소 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DTL_URL_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스상세URL주소 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_FAQ_ADDR /* SAAS제품FAQ주소 */ , A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN /* 상품안내문등록여부 */ , A.PRDCT_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO /* 제품이미지첨부파일그룹번호 */ , A.FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ , B.API_CMNC_SCS_YN /* API통신성공여부 */ , C.ATCH_FILE_SN /* 첨부파일일련번호 */ , COALESCE(D.SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT, 0) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT /* 후기수 */ , COALESCE(TRUNC(D.SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG, 1), 0) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG /* 평균별점 */ , COALESCE(E.SAAS_PRDCT_SUB_CNT, 0) AS SAAS_PRDCT_SUB_CNT /* 제품구독수 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M A LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_CMNC_MNG_L B ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND SRVR_SE_CD = 'A0060002' /* 운영서버 */ LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_ARCH_FILE_L C ON A.PRDCT_IMG_ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO = C.ATCH_FILE_GROUP_NO AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SAAS_PRDCT_ID , COUNT(1) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT , AVG(SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_SCR) AS SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_EVL_L GROUP BY SAAS_PRDCT_ID ) D ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = D.SAAS_PRDCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SAAS_PRDCT_ID , COUNT(1) AS SAAS_PRDCT_SUB_CNT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SAAS_PRDCT_ID, INST_USER_INTG_ID, INST_USER_SE_CD ORDER BY PRDSBSC_SN DESC) AS RN , SAAS_PRDCT_ID , INST_USER_INTG_ID , INST_USER_SE_CD , PRDSBSC_SN , PRDSBSC_STTS_CD FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L ) WHERE RN = 1 AND PRDSBSC_STTS_CD IN ('A0040002', 'A0040004') /* 구독중 */ GROUP BY SAAS_PRDCT_ID, PRDSBSC_STTS_CD ) E ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = E.SAAS_PRDCT_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.SAAS_PRDCT_REV_SCR_AVG DESC NULLS LAST, D.SAAS_PRDCT_REV_CNT DESC, FRST_CRT_DT DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cp.cpm.ProdMapper.select.selectUseProdList - 사용 상품 목록 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* SAAS제품아이디 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD /* SAAS제품제공방식구분코드 */ , SAAS제품유형명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* SAAS제품명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_DTL_CN /* SAAS제품상세내용 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SMRY_CN /* SAAS제품요약내용 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD /* SAAS제품제조사코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_MKR_NM /* SAAS제품제조사명 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN /* SAAS제품API버전일련번호 */ , A.SAAS_PRDCT_SRVC_DMN_ADDR /* SAAS제품서비스도메인주소 */ ,
